g.text: 1 Free nodes: first half kick + drift
and counters remain in FP64 evidence.
Real Velocity-Verlet dynamics — 244 accepted steps, then a safety stop
Dotted lines: first softening / complete failure. Dashed line: Δd > 0.10 stop. Each native step commits exactly once; run 0 never commits.
